description: Machine-checkable subset of compliance.md for Vera Aesthetics. Same UK POM/ASA regime as PureMed (an organic clinic post counts as advertising). Errors block review; warnings need a human look. Patterns are case-insensitive JS regex.

errors.reason: POM brand name — illegal to advertise to the public (CAP 12.12)
POM — do not promote the drug itself; consultation-led 'wrinkle-softening' framing only
No absolute downtime claims — use 'minimal downtime' only if substantiated
No urgency/pressure tactics — off-brand and an ASA sore spot
Em dash — the most recognisable AI tell and a banned character. Rewrite with a comma, colon, or full stop (en dash in ranges like 3–6 months is fine)

warnings.reason: Only if we hold the specific evidence — verify before approving
Price-led content is off-brand; POM price promotion is prohibited — check context
Before/after is never the hero and needs consent — manual approval only, not pipeline content
pomSensitive topic — confirm consultation-led framing, no product name, no price, no drug references
Hype/overclaim vocabulary — Vera never hypes; say the honest thing plainly

warnings.pattern: isn'?t just|not just about|more than just
warnings.reason: AI-tell construction ('isn't just X, it's Y') — rewrite plainly
AI-tell opener — say the thing directly
